title: structure-observation
description: Per-role observation schema for a structure record at code/structures/<slug>.md. Frontmatter MUST carry name (the structure's name as content) and description. The structure spec §7.1 mentions `category` but the corpus does not carry it as a frontmatter cell, and emsenn has confirmed it is neither required nor suggested. Cell-graph signature and invariant conformance is out of band for a flat-file schema and stays out of scope.

name.description: Structure name as content. The filename slug is the address (enforced by the resource-slug check in the envelope's check manifest); the content name may be human-readable with spaces.
